title: What The Bouzouki Knows — EN/EL/ES (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Greek Spanish language learning Mediterranean philosophy
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The bouzouki has a sound that travels faster than the ferry
Between the islands of the Aegean — it's contrary
To the laws of acoustic physics but it doesn't seem to care
The bouzouki makes a sound that's already there when you get there

[Verse 2 — Greek, with English translation]
Το μπουζούκι ξέρει πράγματα που εμείς δεν ξέρουμε ακόμα
[The bouzouki knows things we do not know yet]
Η φωνή του ταξιδεύει πάνω από το Αιγαίο σαν άρωμα
[Its voice travels across the Aegean like a fragrance]
Στα ρεμπέτικα, στις ταβέρνες, στη νύχτα του λιμανιού
[In the rebetiko, in the tavernas, in the harbour night]
Το μπουζούκι λέει αυτά που δεν μπορεί να πει η ψυχή
[The bouzouki says what the soul cannot say]

[Chorus — English]
What does the bouzouki know that I don't know?
It knows the Mediterranean is not a place — it's a tempo and a flow
What does the bouzouki know at two in the morning?
It knows that the best things happen after the usual warning
Has been given and ignored — that's my boy

[Bridge — Spanish, with English translation]
El bouzouki sabe cosas que nosotros no sabemos aún
[The bouzouki knows things we do not know yet]
Su sonido viaja más rápido que los ferries bajo el sol
[Its sound travels faster than the ferries under the sun]
El Mediterráneo no es un lugar — es un tempo y un fluir
[The Mediterranean is not a place — it's a tempo and a flow]
El bouzouki sabe lo que el corazón quiere decir y sentir
[The bouzouki knows what the heart wants to say and feel]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the bouzouki knows… Τι ξέρει το μπουζούκι… Lo que sabe el bouzouki
The Mediterranean is everywhere — Η Μεσόγειος είναι παντού — El Mediterráneo está en todas partes
That's my boy
